subject: Further Information Requested — Proposal CPI/2026/00512
body:
Proposal Number: CPI/2026/00512
Insured: Suryodaya Petrochem Industries Pvt. Ltd.
Broker: Vikram Risk & Insurance Advisors LLP

Dear Vikram Risk & Insurance Advisors LLP,

Following review of Proposal CPI/2026/00512 (Suryodaya Petrochem Industries Pvt. Ltd.), the following is required before a final decision can be issued:
  - Comprehensive Risk Engineering Report (Site Visit Recommended)
  - Detailed Fire Safety Audit Report including Electrical Audit
  - Emergency Response Plan (ERP) for Chemical Spills and Fire Incidents
  - Updated MSDS for all stored chemicals

Regards,
Underwriting Team, Commercial Property Division
reason: Given the significant Total Insured Value (TIV) of INR 940 Crores, high CAT exposure (flood and earthquake), the nature of operations involving bulk storage of highly flammable chemicals, an aged electrical system, and the lack of comprehensive fire protection beyond manual hydrants, this risk requires a full risk engineering assessment including a site visit to assess the adequacy of current risk mitigation measures.
